note: The Bahamas: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 8 months, 3 months, or 90 days (Hong Kong, not extendable); the stay may be extended on arrival (not modelled). Everyone else may get an e-Visa. Indians holding a Schengen, Canadian, UK or US visa or residence, who may enter for 90 days without one, aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Department of Immigration's own pages, whose waiver list (for 3 or 8 months 'as each individual agreement may dictate') and list of the countries needing a visa cover every state between them: Ghana is on the visa list and Benin, Rwanda and Kosovo on neither, so they were moved to the e-Visa the visa list points to; Bosnia and Herzegovina is on the waiver list, which Wikipedia's copy, read before, had left out, and was added at 3 months (the shorter of the two). The United Arab Emirates is on both lists; Wikipedia's 3 months is kept. The pages give the United States' 8 months and the Latin American states' 3; every other length stands on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter the Bahamas without a visa for stays up to the duration listed below. sources.title: Bahamas Department of Immigration: Before Your Arrival
sources.said: In accordance with official international visa regulation agreements, Bahamian visa requirements are waived for citizens of the following countries who wish to visit and remain in The Bahamas for a period not exceeding three (3) months or eight (8) months as each individual agreement may dictate: American Samoa, Andorra, Anguilla, Antigua & Barbuda, Argentina, Armenia, Aruba, Australia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Azores, Bahrain, Bangladesh, Barbados, Belgium, Belize, Bermuda, Bolivia, Bosnia & Herzegovina, ... United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States of America, Uruguay, Vanuatu, Vatican City, Venezuela, Virgin Islands (US & UK), Western Samoa, Zambia And Zimbabwe. On the contrary, citizens of the following countries must make application and obtain Bahamian visas before attempting entry ... Countries that require Bahamian Visa AFGHANISTAN ... GHANA ... UNITED ARAB EMIRATES UZBEKISTAN VIETNAM YEMEN ZAIRE ... https://mofa.gov.bs/evisa-online-services/

sources.title: Bahamas Department of Immigration: Entry Requirements
sources.said: All persons entering The Bahamas require a Bahamian visa except the following persons: United States Citizens entering as a bona fide visitor for a stay not exceeding eight (8) months. ... British Commonwealth citizens with the exception of the following countries: Pakistan. Cameroon. Mozambique. India. Nigeria. Ghana. Citizens of South American countries, however the nationals of the following countries can visit for periods not exceeding 3 months: Argentina. Bolivia. Brazil. Chile. Colombia. Costa Rica. Ecuador. El Salvador. Guatemala. Honduras. Mexico. Nicaragua. Panama. Paraguay. Peru. Uruguay. Venezuela.
